item.title: Portion of Dempster St. reopened in north suburban Niles following vehicle-on-pedestrian crash, police say
item.description: A portion of Dempster Street that was completely closed early Sunday morning in north suburban Niles as authorities investigated a vehicle-on-pedestrian crash has since reopened, according police.

item.title: Chef returns from 'edge of death' to revive culinary career
item.description: Chad Newman, who was hit by a car while riding his bike and faced a long road to recovery, is now back in the kitchen, cooking his signature dish for friends and family, and is looking to re-ignite his catering business.

item.title: Hyde Park residents call for more surveillance after 30 cars were vandalized
item.description: Chicago police are investigating criminal damage to dozens of vehicles in East Hyde Park, leaving residents frustrated and calling for more street surveillance.

item.title: Monday forecast: Clouds linger as temps climb across Chicagoland
